title: WhatsApp assistant
subtitle: Create and manage meetings by WhatsApp message.

row.title: WhatsApp assistant
row.subtitle: Link your account to the WhatsApp bot

explainer: Link your WhatsApp number to create meetings by message. Generate a code here, then send it to the bot from WhatsApp. The code works once and expires after a few minutes.

code.expired: This code has expired. Generate a new one.
code.sendTo: Send this code by WhatsApp to {{number}}

unlink.confirmBody: The bot will stop recognizing your number. You can link it again at any time.

status.unavailable: The WhatsApp assistant is not available yet. Check back soon.

error.rateLimited: You have requested too many codes today. Try again tomorrow.

messages.title: Messages from Meeting Guard AI
messages.explainer: Choose which messages Meeting Guard AI may send you on WhatsApp without you writing first. Reply STOP in the chat to turn them all off.
messages.stopped: You turned these messages off with STOP in the chat. Turn one on here to receive it again.
messages.error: Could not save the change. Try again.

agenda.title: Daily agenda
agenda.hint: Your day at your briefing time, with the full list one tap away.

debrief.title: Debrief prompts
debrief.hint: After a meeting ends, a prompt to note who does what, and by when.

confirmations.title: Meeting confirmations
confirmations.hint: When Meeting Guard AI saves a meeting for you outside this chat.

commitments.title: Commitments to review (pilot)
commitments.hint: When a notetaker summary with commitments is filed.

reminders.title: Task reminders
reminders.hint: At the reminder time of the tasks you accepted from a summary.
